newsitem.title: GREECE: GREEK SHARES PLUNGE 3.7PCT IN SELLOFF.
newsitem.headline: GREEK SHARES PLUNGE 3.7PCT IN SELLOFF.

text.p: Greek equities were down a sharp 3.7 percent or 59 points with the benchmark index at 1,518, adding to Tuesday's 2.94 drop and brokers were baffled by the selloff and the turnaround in sentiment.

"There is continuing pressure on shares of OTE telecom and disappointment over the unexpected weakness after the offering. There seems to be support at 6,600 drachmas and trading is heavy," said a broker.
Banks were taking a heavy hit, down 4.01 percent along with industrials, off 3.94 percent and construction. Losers outpaced gainers 185 to 20 on volume of 15.1 billion drachmas.
